content: The Canadian Academic Detailing Collaboration (CADC) is an organization that encompasses various programs and services aimed at delivering academic detailing, also known as educational outreach, to physicians and other healthcare professionals across Canada. The member programs within this collaboration include the following: The British Columbia Provincial Academic Detailing Service, which has evolved from the original North Shore CDUP. The Academic Detailing program under Alberta Health Services. The RxFiles Academic Detailing Program, based in Saskatchewan. The Prescription Information Service of Manitoba (PRISM). The Dalhousie Academic Detailing Service, located in Nova Scotia. Additionally, the Canadian Agency for Drugs and Technology in Health (CADTH) has compiled and published a comprehensive summary of evidence regarding the effectiveness of academic detailing as an educational and informational intervention for healthcare providers.
